newsitem.title: USA: Thermogenesis seeks clearance for blood monitor.
newsitem.headline: Thermogenesis seeks clearance for blood monitor.

text.p: ThermoGenesis Corp said Monday it had submitted an application to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for 510 clearance to market the HemoMatic Blood Collection Monitor.
In a statement, the company said the device is designed to help automate blood donation through precise monitoring of the flow of blood into collection bags.
ThermoGenesis has exclusive rights to distribute the HemoMatic in the United States and Canada under an agreement with manufacturer HemoPharm Service SA in France.
